pathways.name: Cell Cycle Regulation
pathways.description: Cyclin-CDK machinery controlling cell division; a backbone of oncology target discovery.

pathways.name: Chemokine Signaling
pathways.description: Chemokine-receptor interactions directing leukocyte migration and lymphoid organization.

pathways.name: Coagulation Cascade
pathways.description: Plasma coagulation factors and fibrinolysis; a hub for cardiovascular and thrombotic disease.

pathways.name: DNA Repair

pathways.name: IL-6 Signaling
pathways.description: Interleukin-6 signaling via gp130 and STAT3; a key amplifier of systemic inflammation.

pathways.name: Mast Cell / IgE Signaling

pathways.name: Notch Signaling
pathways.description: Notch receptor signaling regulating cell fate decisions and immune development.

pathways.name: Opioid Signaling
pathways.description: Endogenous and exogenous opioid receptor signaling in pain and analgesia.

pathways.name: PI3K / AKT / mTOR Signaling
pathways.description: Growth and survival signaling through PI3K-AKT-mTOR; a major oncology and immunology target hub.

pathways.name: Renin-Angiotensin System
pathways.description: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone axis controlling blood pressure and fluid balance.

pathways.name: Serotonin / Dopamine Signaling
pathways.description: Monoamine neurotransmission; the pharmacological hub of psychiatry.

pathways.name: Thyroid Hormone Signaling
pathways.description: Thyroid hormone synthesis, transport, and nuclear receptor signaling.

pathways.name: VEGF / Angiogenesis
pathways.description: Vascular endothelial growth factor signaling driving angiogenesis and vascular permeability.
